verdict.rationale: Viam is a cloud-connected platform with a CLI, SDKs and viam-server, so opting out of vendor telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The data-capture features it does describe concern the user's own sensor data synced to the Viam cloud, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.
